title: Project
description: A staged course project. Present only for sections that run one. Structured, cross-referenced values live here rather than in the page prose so the syllabus, the schedule and the project page cannot drift apart.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editor validation.

url.description: Site path of the project page; schedule deadlines derived from the milestones link here.

weight.description: Share of the COURSE grade, as a percentage (25 means 25%). This is not the project's own scale, and `components` do not sum to it.

scale.description: The project's OWN point scale. The milestones (`components`, or the rubric's milestone criteria when the rubric is the milestone list) sum to exactly this.

introduced.description: Date the project is introduced in class, ISO 8601.

due.description: Date the final submission is due, ISO 8601.

dueTime.description: Clock time the final submission is due, as displayed (e.g. 11:59pm).

components.description: The dated pieces the project is marked in; their points must sum to `scale`. Omit when the rubric's milestone criteria are the pieces, so the dates live once.

rubric.description: Final-project grading rubric, rendered by the standalone rubric page.

total.description: Total available points; should equal the sum of each criterion's best level.

levels.description: Achievement-level column headings, best first (e.g. Excellent, Satisfactory, Unsatisfactory).

name.description: Display name of the piece (e.g. Plan, Check-in, Final submission, Demo).

date.description: Date the piece is due, ISO 8601 (interpreted as UTC when formatted). Rendered through the `fullDate` filter — never author a display string here.

points.description: Points this piece carries on the project's own scale.

dueTime.description: When on that date the piece is due, as students read it (e.g. 11:59PM, start of class, in class). Omit when the date is enough. Shown on the schedule beside the date.

matrixCriterion.description: A row of the levels matrix: one criterion scored at each achievement level.

levels.description: One entry per achievement level, in the same order as `rubric.levels`.

milestoneCriterion.description: A dated milestone with a point value, rendered as a row of the milestone table.

id.description: Short label shown above the title (e.g. M1).

due.description: ISO date, rendered through the `fullDate` filter; never a display string.

dueTime.description: Clock time or phrase as students read it (e.g. 11:59PM, in class).

description.description: What work at this level looks like.
